title: Chris Mellon says disclosure 'green light' continued after Clinton's loss

tellings.quote: And so I phoned up Chris the same day. I said, "Chris, so what's going on? Is it dead? Is it No." He said, "Green light still going. It's even bigger than before."

plain: After Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 election, a man named Chris Mellon is said to have insisted that the push to make UFO secrets public, which he called a "green light," had not died but grown. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels he phoned Mellon the same day and asked whether it was dead. Cameron says Mellon answered, "Green light still going. It's even bigger than before," which, if true, would mean the effort, linked in Cameron's telling to the musician Tom DeLonge, did not depend on a Clinton win.
